scope: Simulation scenario development and evidence handoff; no hardware execution or new cloud budget.

homehero: shared skill adapters and outcome checks
workflow composition, recovery and learning records

common_protocol.controller_policy: One frozen controller, calibration and physics configuration per comparison; derive poses from geometry. Any correction creates a new revision evaluated across the same cases.

cases.variation: Changed target pose or approach; record actual settled state
Changed permitted initial joint state or object orientation
Second compatible asset instance at authored scale; if unavailable, deliver a documented gap
Unseen combination of the declared pose and initial-state ranges
Reserved compatible asset instance; if unavailable, no unseen-object claim

freeze_before_execution: numerical case definitions and settled-reset tolerances
common_protocol.attempt_policy: Record each attempt once in an append-only ledger. Preserve planning failures, timeouts, negative controls and native failures. A corrected attempt gets a new ID and revision; no silent overwrite or unchanged retry.
common_protocol.scope_policy: Single native success is a reproducible candidate, not a generalization claim. Export partial success and failed tasks as useful evidence.
common_protocol.gpu_policy: Use the shared isaac_slot.sh lock and bounded jobs. Do not stop HomeHero training or another thread's process. Render after physics when possible.
required_package: manifest.json: scenario, robot, asset, controller and dependency identities; units and coordinate frames; runtime versions
case_definitions.json: frozen case splits, initial conditions, goal predicates and numerical limits
attempts.jsonl: every declared case and attempt, including nonexecuted cases and reasons
source/: executable source snapshots plus hashes; label unavailable historical execution provenance
assets/: USD dependency closure or a reproducible content-addressed locator; preflight results
attempts/<id>/commands: commanded robot joints and timestamps
attempts/<id>/observations: measured joints, objects, mechanism states, target/body-specific contact and force, timestamps
attempts/<id>/result.json: separate process completion, source verdict, stage outcomes and whole-task outcome
attempts/<id>/recording: browser-playable overview/contact video, capture type and timing alignment; failures included
critic.json: human-use semantics, failure diagnosis, uncertain claims and proposed reusable correction
PORTING.md: replay command, dependencies, shared adapter requirements, known gaps and next experiment

scenarios.title: Package microwave release and opening; develop insertion and closure as later stages
scenarios.first_deliverable: Freeze the existing measured press/pop/push sequence and its failures. Reproduce that prefix before extending it.
stages: contact-supported button trip and observed latch release
passive spring opening with the hand clear
hand-driven opening to a measured usable aperture
insert a fitting rigid object and withdraw
close and verify retained contents and latch state
success_requirements: distinguish button actuation, passive pop and hand-driven travel
credit insertion only from measured cavity containment and released support
observe complete closure and latch state for a full workflow pass
preserve stage progress when full aperture or insertion is unreachable
known_gaps: Existing source result reports 66.2 degrees, not an 80-degree opening or an insertion result
Source backlog records approximately 150 seconds of planned push motion
Cabinet cavity collision representation and button-panel finger contact need review
source_backlog_titles: Microwave cabinet colliders: convex hulls fill its cavity in PhysX
Microwave push takes 150 s of planned motion
Open the microwave door past 80 degrees (a dish goes in)
The microwave press jams the index on the panel around the button
scenarios.homehero_follow_on: Reproduce the prefix, then use navigation and reachable base placement for a larger usable aperture; benchmark time and retention independently.
not_required_for_first_delivery: full opening with a permanently fixed base

scenarios.title: Acquire a tool by its intended region, orient it and place it in a tray
scenarios.first_deliverable: One-hand acquisition/transfer with scissors or a graspable screwdriver, followed by the same task on another compatible tool.
stages: if declared, slide a table-supported tool to an accessible edge
acquire with one hand and measured opposing contact
lift, orient for placement and retain
release into a tray and withdraw
success_requirements: declared initial support must match: a hook pickup cannot satisfy a table-edge task
one-hand task must record actual hand identity and cannot be passed by a two-hand workaround
tool ends in the requested tray region and orientation after release
known_gaps: Existing rail-scissors source pass is not proof of a one-hand table-edge task
Current horizontal-loop scissors experiment reports failure
Drill trigger/grip and screw work remain separate capability tasks
source_backlog_titles: Rung 2: Open and close the scissors using only the holding hand's digits.
Thread a digit round a handle: plan the arm and the hand's joints together against the tool's exact surface
scenarios.homehero_follow_on: Reuse the common grasp/transfer judge, then add ROS2 approach and noncontact arm staging.
not_required_for_first_delivery: in-hand dexterity beyond the declared reorientation

scenarios.title: Store and retrieve fitting objects in an already-open drawer
scenarios.first_deliverable: A fitting object placed in and retrieved from a measured open cavity; preserve the authored object scale.
stages: verify open cavity and object fit
insert, release, withdraw and verify containment
retrieve the requested object and place it on the staging surface
add contact-driven closing, then opening as separate extensions
success_requirements: entire object is inside the measured cavity after release
withdrawal does not drag the object out
retrieval preserves the requested object identity and stable supported placement
drawer motion must follow its declared passive mechanism and measured hand contact
known_gaps: The existing HomeHero cabinet fixture is a commissioning model with assumed mass/damping
Closed-drawer lip hooking is not required to begin storage lessons
Cavity fit and collision coverage need validation for each compatible drawer
scenarios.homehero_follow_on: Compose store/retrieve/close in the current cabinet curriculum, then vary drawers, objects and rooms.

homehero_acceptance: Evidence intake: identity, dependency and recording integrity; failures accepted as failures
Freeze an independent copy and reproduce declared cases without changing the source controller
Compare stage and whole-task evidence; mechanism, support, hand-count and order must match the requested task
Evaluate predeclared variations with the same controller; retain reserved cases and every failure
Integrate shared adapters and workflow ownership; add Nav2 and arm staging as a separately measured experiment
